title: Crestline Credit Card Purchases in the Past 12 Months: Returned-Fee Courtesy Addition
content:
Northgate's returned-fee courtesy credit on the Crestline Credit Card recognizes use of the card: when the purchases posted to the account fewer than 12 months before today total at least 1,500 USD (1500.0) and at least one of them carries a promotional plan, 0.1 is added to the share of the returned payment fee that the courtesy credit returns; when they total at least 750 USD (750.0) without meeting that test, 0.05 is added; otherwise nothing is added. The share, with every addition made to it, never exceeds 1.0 — the whole fee.

**Records read:** the purchase entries on the card ledger posted fewer than 12 months before today, their amounts, and whether each carries a deferred-interest or equal-payment plan.

## Truth table

| Total of those purchases | One or more on a promotional plan | Added |
|---|---|---|
| 1,500 USD or more | yes | 0.1 |
| 1,500 USD or more | no | 0.05 |
| 750 USD or more, below 1,500 USD | yes or no | 0.05 |
| below 750 USD | yes or no | nothing |

A total exactly on a threshold meets it. Hypothetical cases: 1,620.00 USD with one 12-month deferred purchase, 0.1; 1,620.00 USD all standard, 0.05; 700.00 USD on a plan, nothing.
